title: Identity and composition equations of integral scalar duality comparisons
statement: Fix D,l,E⊂L,X and coherent dualizing data wE,wL, and any normalized tensor-Hom presentations a,b [def-sf-integral-hom-reduction-models] whose evaluation counits are natural in the first tensor variable. The prescribed u,v,beta and the completion-conjugated unit/comp maps [def-sf-integral-finite-extension-core] satisfy IdentityConclusion for E and L, and CompositionConclusion for every further finite coefficient extension L→F, coherent dualizing datum wF and normalized tensor presentation c with the same first-variable evaluation naturality. These are the three comparison composition equations, the two associator unit equations and the associator pentagon on actual ambient maps. No isomorphism, finite reduction or double-dual assertion is included.

source.place: Final paragraph: unit, composition and tensor associator equations for u, v and beta.

proof.text: Apply the E-side identity component theorem. Its conclusion is exactly the three identity-extension equations for E, with the prescribed unit, v and beta maps.
Apply the L-side identity component theorem. It gives the same identity-extension equations with L as coefficient field.
Apply the composition component theorem to the fixed presentations and its first-variable evaluation naturality hypothesis. This gives the universal CompositionConclusion clause.

proof_origin.place: Final paragraph: split into the E identity, L identity and universal composition components of the unit, composition and associator equations.
